scope: Read-only review of creator source/cards and existing result summaries. No Godot run, no source mutation, no production approval, no human fun judgment.
count_policy: Only new distinct causal player experiences with executable evidence may become technical_candidate_distinct. Proposal, executable_not_yet_validated, and possible_duplicate count zero. A variant sharing the same observation-decision-resource loop does not add a family. Old six and two-box Macro add zero new families.

status_meanings.proposal_unique_hypothesis: Plausibly distinct player decision and causal state change; no executable validation claimed.
status_meanings.possible_duplicate: A specific parent/shared decision remains unresolved; does not count separately even if execution succeeds.
status_meanings.executable_not_yet_validated: Some source or clean probe exists; independent counterexamples/regular validation or novelty evidence remains incomplete.
status_meanings.technical_candidate_distinct: Finite evidence supports an independently different causal relationship. Not human fun or production approval.
status_meanings.rejected: Withdrawn, unsupported, or presently a serial/parameter variant without a new decision. Versioned rework remains possible.

rows.observation_decision: Keep the second jump until the body clears a low overhang.
rows.causal_change: Same finite jump resource succeeds only after a spatial release point.
rows.terrain_necessity: Overhang must obstruct early ascent and far high bank require late ascent.
rows.basis: Card describes different timing from recoil brake; no result reviewed yet.

rows.observation_decision: Spend second jump to reach wall, restore it, spend again.
rows.causal_change: Wall jump restores remaining jump resource.
rows.terrain_necessity: Finite wall prevents ordinary continuous wall ascent.
rows.basis: Different contact Cell alone does not distinguish the same exhaust-touch-refill-spend loop from grapple/jump-refill.

rows.observation_decision: Commit to walking off a ledge to obtain a wall contact and reverse upward.
rows.causal_change: Capability absent at entry becomes available through falling contact, not a resource pickup.
rows.terrain_necessity: No-jump configuration and wall below ledge must force commitment before escape.
rows.basis: Plausibly distinct entry commitment; no validated route reviewed.

rows.observation_decision: Alternate sides of a shaft rather than remain on one wall.
rows.causal_change: Cross-shaft contact refreshes wall-jump opportunity while gaining height.
rows.terrain_necessity: Finite separated walls must invalidate single-wall repetition.
rows.basis: Multi-contact count alone insufficient; opposite-side necessity is decisive.

rows.parent: ordinary grounded resource reset; serial gaps
rows.observation_decision: Land on intermediate island, then jump again.
rows.causal_change: Default grounded restoration.
rows.terrain_necessity: Island length/range alone.
rows.basis: Serial standard jump sections do not add a family. Creator explicitly agreed withdrawal in message.

rows.observation_decision: Acquire a stable aerial origin and choose a deliberate launch.
rows.causal_change: Hang clears velocity; anchor jump starts from a new supported position.
rows.terrain_necessity: New origin must be necessary for reaching high bank.
rows.basis: Distinct contact/launch hypothesis, but no technical certification.

rows.observation_decision: Aim a second hook around an occluding corner.
rows.causal_change: New target selection could change path topology.
rows.terrain_necessity: Occluder must hide second target at entry and prevent direct first-to-exit launch.
rows.basis: Two hooks are not a new family unless geometry changes what target can be selected and why.

rows.parent: timed-cache temporal window; proposed wall timed dwell
rows.observation_decision: Wait at an aerial refuge then launch through hazard window.
rows.causal_change: Safe observation point may make timing physically possible.
rows.terrain_necessity: Waiting on entry must not reproduce same opportunity cheaply.
rows.basis: Adding a saw to anchor-gap does not by itself add a new decision.

rows.observation_decision: Spend second jump to reach hook, restore it, spend again.
rows.causal_change: Hook contact restores finite jump resource.
rows.terrain_necessity: Hook must be inaccessible without prior expenditure and far bank require renewed jump.
rows.basis: Currently one shared restored-jump family with wall renewal, not two.

rows.observation_decision: Repair forced bounce trajectory with recoil.
rows.causal_change: Forced departure could remove the option to wait and create a new commitment.
rows.terrain_necessity: Natural bounce and direct recoil must miss the pocket.
rows.basis: Same recoil landing correction remains parent unless forced departure creates a different player decision.

rows.observation_decision: Choose departing platform phase for inherited momentum.
rows.causal_change: Claimed persistent inherited velocity not established.
rows.terrain_necessity: Would require reachability change from platform velocity.
rows.basis: Creator reports Motor rebuilds normal_velocity each frame so inheritance survives only first frame; both v1 probes out_of_bounds. No novelty credited.

rows.observation_decision: Walk off at sufficient elevation while avoiding overhead rock.
rows.causal_change: Sustained carrier height provides otherwise unavailable side opening.
rows.terrain_necessity: High opening and ceiling must jointly constrain exit, rather than generic wait-to-top.
rows.basis: v1 lift-0.44 settled_goal, lift-0.37 out_of_bounds. Revised low-top walkoff is not yet reviewed; ordinary elevator use is insufficient novelty alone.

rows.observation_decision: Read relative position of two supports and transfer while they meet.
rows.causal_change: Two moving spatial supports, not just two grounded refills, create a changing transfer opportunity.
rows.terrain_necessity: Neither single carrier nor direct second-carrier entry may reach exit.
rows.basis: v1 both probes timeout before second support; executable success not established.

rows.observation_decision: Enter the space just vacated by a moving hazard and keep advancing before return.
rows.causal_change: A moving forbidden volume turns stopping after entry into failure; revised proposal exits by dropping below track.
rows.terrain_necessity: Low roof prevents jumping over saw; final floor drop must remove player from return track.
rows.basis: All v1 samples real_damage; revision remains proposal.

rows.observation_decision: Pass a hazard layer then reverse into pocket.
rows.causal_change: Saw may be only an extra obstacle on an existing reversal.
rows.terrain_necessity: Must demonstrate a phase-dependent choice beyond existing ledge brake.
rows.basis: Hazard addition does not count without an independent new decision.

rows.observation_decision: Brace against wall and repeatedly shoot blocking enemy.
rows.causal_change: Death removes contact blockade; wall absorbs own recoil.
rows.terrain_necessity: Ceiling prevents jump over; backing wall must materially affect firing feasibility.
rows.basis: v1 spacing24/30 killed enemy without player damage but frame_budget; spacing12/18 damage. No stable exit validation. Same fixed-volley family as absorber until decision differs.

rows.observation_decision: Fire three times into enemy then fire again at exposed bell.
rows.causal_change: Enemy death exposes same ray, followed by an ordinary switch action.
rows.terrain_necessity: Aiming around enemy/waiting until it moves must fail.
rows.basis: v1 spacing18/24/30 settled_goal with enemy_defeated then bell_open, but success does not distinguish fixed-volley clearing from brace-clearance. Fourth shot alone is serial action, not new family.

rows.parent: move living blocker to change firing geometry; risk kill-to-clear variant
rows.observation_decision: Reposition a live enemy to open a different firing line.
rows.causal_change: Persistent enemy position changes later projectile occlusion.
rows.terrain_necessity: Shooting position/occluder must require actual displacement.
falsifiers: kill enemy then bell with equal or lower cost
rows.basis: Potentially separate only if keeping/moving alive changes a real tradeoff. Checker must permit legitimate killing alternatives rather than fail them solely for lacking intended live-state tag.

rows.parent: timed-cache uses opening; this proposal uses restored occlusion
rows.observation_decision: Pass through an opening then depend on its closure for cover.
rows.causal_change: Gate collision returns before incoming enemy projectile reaches exit.
rows.terrain_necessity: No other cover or cheap sprint route may replace restored gate.
rows.basis: Reinterpreting closure as useful world state is plausibly distinct, not yet validated.

rows.observation_decision: Expose high position to lock shot, then relocate low before firing.
rows.causal_change: Player deliberately changes future projectile direction; not passive phase waiting.
rows.terrain_necessity: High bait position and low passage must produce distinct actual firing ray.
rows.basis: Strong independent causal hypothesis if real locked aim and low-route necessity are demonstrated.

rows.observation_decision: Land at intermediate island to recharge then repeat jump/recoil.
rows.causal_change: Default grounded reset only.
rows.terrain_necessity: Two serial range gaps.
rows.basis: Creator and parent explicitly exclude ordinary landing relay from new family count.

rows.parent: spatial remote unlock with return commitment
rows.observation_decision: Move away from target to obtain line of sight, unlock it, then return.
rows.causal_change: Permanent remote world-state change makes an earlier blocked route traversable.
rows.terrain_necessity: Actual occluding rock must invalidate prefire and alternative sight lines.
rows.basis: Potential new spatial dependency, not direct same-shot temporal gate traversal.

rows.observation_decision: Hit one bell to expose next station, move, hit next bell.
rows.causal_change: Ordered state machine with spatially inaccessible second receiver.
rows.terrain_necessity: First state must change discoverability/access to second rather than just add another door.
rows.basis: Two ordered switches can be a serial lock task; separate count requires different planning/observation from remote-unlock backtrack, not sequence_step field alone.

rows.observation_decision: Fall below occluder, shoot down to unlock and rise into side pocket.
rows.causal_change: Single recoil both moves body and opens gate, from spatially restricted ray.
rows.terrain_necessity: Only correct lower shooting region may offer line of sight.
rows.basis: Promising composition, but currently a concatenation of baseline line-of-sight recoil gate and pocket correction; prove a new incompatible choice rather than both old requirements.

rows.observation_decision: Start platform then take separate ground route to intercept it.
rows.causal_change: Same start/pursue moving-support state as chase-landing; walking route changes approach.
rows.terrain_necessity: Alternative ground route must induce an independent choice, not just replace a jump approach.
rows.basis: Current card changes route to moving support, not the central player decision. Recommended replacing with trapdoor or moving cover.
